mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_adjustment_record ( ticket_category_id, operator_user_id, adjust_quantity, before_available_stock, after_available_stock, before_redis_stock, after_redis_stock, reason, status, confirm_token, confirmed_at, rollback_available, rollback_record_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ticketCategoryId}, #{operatorUserId}, #{adjustQuantity}, #{beforeAvailableStock}, #{afterAvailableStock}, #{beforeRedisStock}, #{afterRedisStock}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{confirmToken}, #{confirmedAt}, #{rollbackAvailable}, #{rollbackRecordId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_category_id, operator_user_id, adjust_quantity, before_available_stock, after_available_stock, before_redis_stock, after_redis_stock, reason, status, confirm_token, confirmed_at, rollback_available, rollback_record_id, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_adjustment_record WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, ticket_category_id, operator_user_id, adjust_quantity, before_available_stock, after_available_stock, before_redis_stock, after_redis_stock, reason, status, confirm_token, confirmed_at, rollback_available, rollback_record_id, created_at, updated_at FROM stock_adjustment_record ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_adjustment_record SET status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND confirm_token = #{confirmToken} AND status = 'PENDING_CONFIRM'

UPDATE stock_adjustment_record SET status = 'ROLLBACK_RECORDED', before_available_stock = #{beforeAvailableStock}, after_available_stock = #{afterAvailableStock}, before_redis_stock = #{beforeRedisStock}, after_redis_stock = #{afterRedisStock}, rollback_available = true, rollback_record_id = #{rollbackRecordId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CONFIRMED'
UPDATE stock_adjustment_record SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING_CONFIRM', 'CONFIRMED')
